correctness.rationale: Proof checked: rotating-frame radial/tangent derivative of z|z|² is (3ρ,φ), giving J0=diag(-2,0) and Jh=[[3u,-v],[3v,u]]. Fourier eigenvalues of directed 3-cycle are λ,conj λ. Traceless C²=Δ²I and real tr(conj C C)=2h yield det=e^(-2Bτ), real tr=e^(-Bτ)[(1+r)cosh(2ξτ)+(1-r)cos(2ητ)]. Real 2×2 Schur test yields exact strict criterion. Large-v asymptotics make positive-phase peaks violate while interlaced troughs satisfy criterion for any prescribed finite N, with one chosen finite v; does not imply infinitely many windows at fixed v. Source verification code was read but not executed; exponential formulas independently inspected algebraically.
